title: French Stereotype Pillager
description: This texture pack turns your pillagers into the French stereotype!
body:
This resource pack replaces the default Pillager visuals and sounds with a humorous French-inspired redesign.

Pillagers receive custom textures featuring themed clothing and facial details, while their original model and animations remain unchanged for full vanilla compatibility. In addition, the Pillager ambient and laugh sounds are replaced with a French-style laugh for added comedic effect.

The pack is purely cosmetic and does not alter any gameplay mechanics. It is intended for players who enjoy parody-style resource packs, themed worlds, or light-hearted visual and audio tweaks. Compatible with other mods and resource packs that do not override Pillager textures or sounds.
